title: Managing Active Directory Attribute Collection Settings

blocks.text: Zscaler ITDR collects Active Directory (AD) domain object (users and computers) attributes. After an AD domain is configured for scanning, attribute collection is enabled by default. The Windows endpoint agent assigned for scanning the AD domain collects the attributes. You can also schedule the scan frequency.

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Manage > Active Directory Posture.
Locate the AD domain for which you want to enable or disable attribute collection, and click the Edit icon.
In the Scan Agents Details window, under Attribute Collection:
Enabled: Attribute collection is enabled by default. Click the toggle to disable it.
Scan Frequency: Select a scan frequency (Weekly or Monthly) for attribute collection.
